rawCandidates.title: Graph construction creates ownership-unbound neighbor edges from a shared agent table
rawCandidates.source: New captures and recent memories are loaded from the per-agent table, which can contain multiple workspace/user scopes, while the graph edge model contains only record IDs.
rawCandidates.control: Semantic vector search, temporal, entity, and emotional linking at 370-457 have no scope/ownership predicate; index.js:4767-4783 supplies recent rows without scope fields.
rawCandidates.sink: The resulting ID-only edges are appended to the active workspace graph and later feed graph-only hydration, whose metadata-loss/ACL fail-open path is recorded in cand-acl-missing-ownership-fail-open.
rawCandidates.impact: If records from different protected scopes share an agent DB and a foreign ID is linked into a reachable graph, a later graph recall can expose it despite final response ACL.
rawCandidates.closestControl: Normal vector mapping preserves storedBy/workspaceKey and checkAccess can use them; graph edges should preserve or enforce the same scope boundary before insertion/traversal.
rawCandidates.validationFacts: Dynamic validation will use a fake table with a protected foreign row to show the edge is created and combine it with the existing hydration proof. Final exploitability depends on the configured agent/workspace sharing topology and graph reachability, which must be stated explicitly.
rawCandidates.attackFacts: Requires one agent serving more than one protected scope, graph construction enabled, and a semantically/temporally/entity/emotionally matching foreign row. A repair can retain associative recall by filtering or binding edges by scope before graph persistence and preserving full ownership metadata through hydration.

rawCandidates.title: Graph constellation report follows vault-directory symlinks outside the workspace
rawCandidates.source: A writable workspace/vault can contain a symlink at memory, graph, year, or month below workspaceDir.
rawCandidates.control: writeGraphConstellationReport constructs a lexical path with join, then mkdirSync and writeFileSync it without resolveInside, lstat, realpath containment, or no-follow protection.
rawCandidates.sink: writeFileSync writes the predictable constellation-YYYY-MM-DD.md file at the symlink-resolved destination (lib/memory-graph.js:601-605); index.js invokes it probabilistically from the capture hook at 4816-4825.
rawCandidates.impact: A user who can modify the vault tree can redirect a plugin-process write outside the intended workspace, potentially overwriting a same-named file in a writable target directory.
rawCandidates.closestControl: Repository guidance requires resolveInside before every file write; other vault helpers use controlled path resolution. This writer has no equivalent containment guard.
rawCandidates.validationFacts: A bounded temp-directory PoC can create workspace/memory/graph as a symlink to a temp outside directory, call the exported function with one edge, and verify the returned path/file lands outside the workspace. No product source changes are required.
rawCandidates.attackFacts: Requires write/symlink control within the configured workspace and a graph report invocation (or direct trusted API call); the automatic hook samples at 10%. Preserve reports by resolving and verifying each parent/target under a canonical workspace root and rejecting symlinks rather than disabling graph output.
